description.short_caption: Axial CT of the abdomen showing intra-abdominal structures.
description.detailed_description: This axial CT image of the abdomen demonstrates various intra-abdominal structures, including the vertebral column centrally, the kidneys laterally, and bowel loops. The image is grayscale, with soft tissue and fluid densities visible. No contrast enhancement is apparent, suggesting it may be a non-contrast study. There are no overt signs of abnormal masses, fluid collections, or other pathology visible in this image.

description.short_caption: Gram stain showing numerous neutrophils and gram-positive cocci in clusters.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Gram stain of an aspirate. Numerous polymorphonuclear neutrophils are visible, characterized by their multi-lobed nuclei. Interspersed among the neutrophils are gram-positive cocci arranged in clusters, which is suggestive of a staphylococcal species. The background appears to contain some amorphous material, likely representing cellular debris.
visible_findings: Numerous polymorphonuclear neutrophils with multi-lobed nuclei

Case_15004/figure6.jpg.source_caption: Overnight growth of Proteus mirabilis on MacConkey agar.

description.short_caption: Overnight growth of Proteus mirabilis on MacConkey agar.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a culture plate containing MacConkey agar with visible bacterial growth. The colonies appear to spread in a swarming pattern, which is characteristic of Proteus species. The agar is light pink, consistent with MacConkey medium, and there is no evidence of lactose fermentation, as the colonies are not pink. Black boxes obscure some text on the plate, but the visible growth pattern strongly suggests Proteus mirabilis.

description.short_caption: Coronal CT of the abdomen showing multiple hypodense lesions in the liver and kidneys.
description.detailed_description: This coronal CT image of the abdomen demonstrates multiple hypodense lesions in both the liver and kidneys, suggestive of abscesses or cystic lesions. The liver appears enlarged, and the lesions are of varying sizes. The kidneys also show similar hypodense areas, with the right kidney appearing slightly more affected. The image is in a soft tissue window, providing clear visualization of the abdominal organs and potential pathology.
visible_findings: multiple hypodense lesions in the liver
